Food and services are not up to par
Aug 2023 • Couples
I gave 2 stars to be generated since the place is clean and is inside of the mall. The food was not good at all. The banh beo we ordered tasted ok, but the dipping fish sauce was terrible. I have never eaten fish sauce that was so sweet and no fish sauce taste ever. The bun Bo hue (VN spicy noodle soup) picture looks good on the printed menu, but the taste was so bland that it tastes like beef broth from a can. No spice or lemongrass at all. It more like bland bun Bo, but not bun Bo hue. The service staff could not even set the table correctly. When they bought the soups to us, there was no napkins or chopsticks. We have to ask for them.

Bad Service, Food Subpar
Jan 2020 • Family
My brother and I came to this restaurant because we wanted to eat bun bo hue. We could of had our family take us to a better place like a street vendor but we didn't want to bother them so we settled for mall food. Anyways we got seated right away, since we knew what we wanted to eat we ordered 2 bowls of the bun bo hue with crab meatball and flank steak and 2 bottled water. We wait and notice 2 Ladies who get seated in front of us after we placed our orders. Immediately they get the same food that we ordered, I don't even recall anyone coming to take their orders. Anyways we sit there for another 20 mins, still no food delivered not even our bottle waters came. There were 4 servers just standing around, no one coming to ask if we were okay or even asked if we ordered yet (even though we ordered our food already). My brother told me we should wait but I was hangry so I called the lady and ask 'where's our food?' they look confused and start scrabbling through their receipts to try and pull up the order that we made. In 2 mins our order came out. The food was okay, it was enough to get rid of that bun bo hue craving but definitely not the best.
